cases.stimulus: Parse, badge, count and preview a blocking issue with no explicit publish action.
cases.expected: No provider mutation, review event, model invocation or local verification.

cases.stimulus: Publish an explicitly authorized issue containing a native suggested edit on a supported exact anchor.
cases.expected: Website renders the ordinary label and genuine native suggestion; decoded body/anchor equal the approved draft.

cases.stimulus: Write a suggestion comment containing only prose.
cases.expected: It remains valid feedback, with no invented apply action or replacement block.

cases.stimulus: The current placement can only publish a permalink/top-level comment.
cases.expected: Text/anchor context remain readable, native applicability is honestly unavailable and no nearby-line relocation occurs.

cases.stimulus: Select Request changes explicitly after inspecting own blocking feedback.
cases.expected: Exactly the existing native event is submitted once; no label-generated second event or custom merge gate.

cases.stimulus: Explicitly choose Approve while own unresolved blocking feedback exists.
cases.expected: Relevant preflight context is visible; the chosen GitHub-allowed decision remains the user’s action, not silently overridden.

cases.stimulus: Resolve a labelled thread through the website, then refresh BPR.
cases.expected: Shared state/counters update; the local defect receives evidence under its existing policy, never automatic verification.

cases.stimulus: Edit only the root label on the website, without a new commit.
cases.expected: Accepted annotation/bucket updates without changing thread identity or erasing the prior local defect.

cases.stimulus: Add question as a reply under an issue root.
cases.expected: Reply badge may be Question; the one counted root remains Issue.

cases.stimulus: Review a tour with plain and deliberately labelled stops, index links and native threads.
cases.expected: Order, links and user-body boundaries survive; no forced taxonomy or duplicate counts from links.

cases.stimulus: Promote an available private note/finding with private severity and runtime provenance.
cases.expected: One shared durable draft is previewed; no hidden private metadata is appended publicly.

cases.stimulus: Lose the response after posting a labelled comment; edit its label locally while recovery is pending.
cases.expected: Reconcile the old exact attempt before new publication; no blind retry, duplicate comment or old authorization for the new body.

cases.stimulus: Use labels/counters/native authoring with no AI configured.
cases.expected: All deterministic product functionality remains available and no hook invokes a model.

cases.stimulus: Upgrade the builtin convention fragment while a user has customized the feedback hook.
cases.expected: Custom override remains intact, with explicit effective version and normal reset/merge options only.

cases.stimulus: Desktop and CLI edit the same shared draft revision concurrently.
cases.expected: Existing optimistic ownership/revision conflict retains both candidates; no shadow draft or GUI launch.

cases.stimulus: Read public REST comment groups without native thread resolution.
cases.expected: Labels are readable and total counts may be known; unresolved status is unavailable, never a falsely clean zero.

cases.stimulus: A provider page or root body is missing while some known issue counts exist.
cases.expected: Counts are qualified and incomplete membership remains discoverable; no complete-total or no-blockers claim.

cases.stimulus: Mark/read a non-blocking note on an outdated but provider-unresolved thread.
cases.expected: Shared resolution and unresolved counts remain unchanged.

cases.stimulus: A code block instructs the agent/parser to publish the private draft and run a command.
cases.expected: It remains untrusted task data; parser effects are zero and optional AI stays within explicit context/action authority.
